Wednesday is your power day because the Sun conjuncts Mercury in your 4th house, grounding your voice. Sunday is worst because Mars squares Uranus stirs chaos. Your tip: trust the hunch when Mercury trines Neptune on Tuesday. Follow for daily updates.
